arguments.sql: SELECT SUM(t.amount_usd_cents) / 100.0 AS total_amount_usd FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id WHERE c.credit_limit_usd_cents > 2000000
arguments.explanation: Returns the total amount, in dollars, of all transactions made on cards whose credit limit is above $20,000.
assumptions: All transactions are summed, including those with negative amounts, because what negative amounts mean is not documented.
The whole data period is covered, 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
